title: 胎藏梵字真言
content:
No. 854
胎藏梵字真言上卷


灑淨真言：

◇namaḥsamantabuddhānāṃ◇apratisame◇gaganasame◇samantānugate◇prakṛtiviśuddhe◇dharmadhātuviśodhani◇svāhā◇


持地真言曰：


namaḥsamantabuddhānāṃ◇sarvatathāgatā◇dhiṣṭānādhiṣṭiteacale◇vimale◇smaraṇe◇prakṛtipariśuddhesvāhā◇


持香水真言曰（押紙：已下經二，具緣品）：

namaḥsamantabuddhānāṃaḥmahāśāntigataśāntikara◇praśamadharmanirjjata◇abhāvasvāhāvadharsasa□nāprāpta◇svāhā◇
